facts.text: Serve the mains when the friends take over the cooking on the trail.
facts.why: The filmsite summary and Wikipedia do not say the three friends take over the cooking. They do clearly show Cookie driving the chuck wagon off a cliff and wrecking the food supply.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Cookie sends the chuck wagon over the cliff.

facts.text: Eat up, city boy. Out here supper's beans and coffee, and you'll be grateful for both.
facts.why: Not a Curly line. His famous speech is 'One thing. Just one thing.' This one is printed in quote marks and its 'beans and coffee' talk is not in his dialogue.
Bonnie Rayburn is a fellow paying guest on the drive, not a cowhand. The ranch hands are Jeff and T.R.
facts.fix: Bonnie, a guest on the drive

vibe.verdict: A fair chuck wagon board and Curly's finger is in, but the food skips the film's own jokes and the signed note is invented.
missing: Curly's 'One thing. Just one thing.' (riding with Mitch)
Barry and Ira's ice cream flavour game: 'Rum raisin!'
Cookie driving the chuck wagon off the cliff
Mitch's battery coffee grinder starting the stampede (early morning camp)
Norman the calf, bottle fed (after Mitch delivers him)
Phil on Curly: 'The man ate bacon at every meal.'
ideas: Swap 'Fry bread with honey and chilli' for 'Rum raisin ice cream cones', note 'Barry's pick. Ira got the high five.'
Replace the Curly note with the real line, 'One thing. Just one thing.'
Swap 'Prickly pear lemonade' for 'Coffee grinder cold brew', note 'Mitch started a stampede with one of these.'
Swap 'Chuckwagon coffee with cinnamon cream' note for 'Curly ate bacon at every meal. Have the coffee too.'
